from scipy.linalg import eigh

   B=complex((np.exp(1j*L)+1)/2);F=complex((np.exp(1j*L)+np.exp(1j*(L-R)))/2)
   s[i,j]=m.canonical(*m.split_route_half(g,.04,B,F),a)

for l in range(-10,11):

print(json.dumps(dict(actual_auxiliary_grid32_vs64_max_Fourier_block_absolute_defect=max(errs),compared_delta_kL=list(range(-10,11)),compared_delta_kR=list(range(-8,9)),all6_canonical_auxiliary_states=True,interpretation="Field quadrature check only; NOT electric regulator cutoff bias",source_sha256_at_import={n:m.hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() for n,b in m.SOURCE_BYTES_AT_IMPORT.items()})))
